title: Networking Message Writer — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Drafts professional outreach messages that get answered. The Networking Message Writer drafts professional outreach messages. Whether it is a cold message to an alum, a follow-up after a career fair, or a thank-you after an informational interview, it writes a short, specific, respectful message with a clear ask. The tone is professional but human — never a mass template.
capabilities: Draft cold outreach to alumni and pros
Keep messages short with a clear ask
